record.text: Apple has introduced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone featuring a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer screen. Powered by the A20 Pro chip and iOS 27, the device integrates advanced Apple Intelligence features. It will be available starting October 23.
